FirstRunVm_ChooseLogsFolderTitle: Choose the EQ2 logs folder (server subfolders are scanned too)
FirstRun_Intro: To parse your fights, EQ2Parser watches your EverQuest II log folder — any character whose log becomes active is picked up automatically. In game, make sure logging is on (type /log).
FirstRun_NoCandidates: No EQ2 install was auto-detected. Browse to your EverQuest II folder and pick its 'logs' subfolder (e.g. …\steamapps\common\EverQuest 2\logs).
FirstRun_SkipTooltip: You can set the folder any time on the Sources page

Main_TooltipArchive: Search every stored fight (bosses never age out) and pull them back into the parser
Main_TooltipCuration: Mine archived fights: what each mob casts, measured recast timings, and which abilities still need timers
Main_TooltipFreq: Mean time between uses (multi-hit volleys count once)
Main_TooltipPerspective: Perspective: whose log this view is built from. Combined merges every witness (each character's own log wins for their numbers).
MiniParse_EmptyHint: The current fight's meter appears here.
Notifications_EmptyHint: Trigger alerts pop up here for a few seconds.

Overlays_AutoHide: Hide overlays when neither EQ2 nor the parser is focused
Overlays_AutoHideTip: For single-screen setups: alt-tabbing to Discord (or anything else) hides the overlay windows; focusing EQ2 or the parser brings them straight back. Leave off on multi-monitor setups.
Overlays_FadeMetersTip: The DPS, Healing and Tanking meters fade out this many seconds after combat ends (locked overlays only — an unlocked meter stays visible so you can drag it). Untick to keep them visible after fights.
Overlays_FooterHint: Run any combination — all three meters at once if you like. Timers route to panel A or B per timer (the panel checkboxes in each timer's editor).
Overlays_Intro: In-game windows that float over EQ2. Show one, drag it into place, then lock it — locked overlays are click-through, never steal focus, and vanish entirely while they have nothing to say. Every change here applies to the live window instantly.
Overlays_ResizeHint: Drag the corner grip to resize — rows fill the space (fit the whole raid for streaming).
Raid_BadPoints: Points must be a number between 1 and 1000.
Raid_DkpHint: Queues one award for everyone in raid plus the ticked sit-outs. Each press of the DKP macro applies ONE award and announces it to officer chat — the file advances automatically; keep pressing until the status says done. Every applied change is also recorded in dkp-ledger.log.
Raid_DkpQueued: {0} award commands queued — press the DKP macro in game.
Raid_DkpProgress: {0} of {1} awards applied — press the DKP macro again.
Raid_DkpThrottled: Still throttled — wait a few seconds, then press the DKP macro again.
Raid_DkpResetWarn: {0} of {1} awards from the current batch are already applied. Writing a new file starts the batch over — players already awarded would receive DKP again. Continue?
Raid_FileError: Could not write the command file: {0} — set a writable folder in Settings.
Raid_FileWritten: Wrote {0} — run your /do_file_commands macro in game.
Raid_HowToIntro: In game, create three macros — one per command file:
Raid_HowToSteps:
1. At raid start hit the ROSTER macro in game — the /who results seed the lists; joins and leaves then update automatically from the log (the command files themselves are written for you).
2. To award DKP: set points and reason above, tick the sit-outs that count, press "Write DKP file", then hit the DKP macro in game.
3. To charge loot: check buyers and costs below, then hit the LOOT macro until every row shows charged ✓.
Note: the game gives no log feedback for points commands — awards are fire-and-forget.
Raid_NewSessionTip: Clears the roster for a new raid night.
Raid_NoInstallDir: EQ2 install folder not found from the log paths — set it in Settings.
Raid_LootHint: Chest drops appear here as they're opened; the buyer auto-fills when someone loots the item (edit it for trades) and the cost starts at the min bid. The loot file stays in sync by itself — each press of the LOOT macro charges ONE item, announces it to officer chat (with the item link), and ticks the row charged ✓ once the deduction is confirmed. Every applied change is also recorded in dkp-ledger.log.
Raid_LootMinBidTip: Newly-dropped items start at this DKP cost.
Raid_LootDeleteTip: Remove this row — not bought loot (materials, collection pieces…).
Raid_DupApplied: ⚠ A charge that was already confirmed just applied AGAIN in game (double press or two officers). See the last line of dkp-ledger.log and correct in game.
Raid_LootProgress: {0} loot charges remaining — press the loot macro again.
Raid_MainsActive: Main mapping loaded from EQ2Lexicon ({0} characters) — DKP is awarded to each raider's MAIN, even when they are on an alt.
Raid_MainsInactive: No main mapping yet — DKP goes to whichever character is in raid. It loads automatically while uploads are on.
Raid_SitOutHint: Online guildmates not in the raid. Tick who earns sit-out DKP.
Raid_WriteDkpTip: Writes /guild points commands for everyone in raid plus the ticked sit-outs. Run the macro in game to award.

Settings_AnnounceMassDetrimentsTip:
When several players get hit by the same control effect at once, speak it — “8 players stunned”.
Detected straight from the log's status lines; no per-boss setup needed.
Settings_ApiTokenHint: Create a token on the EQ2Lexicon site (sign in with Discord → account menu → API tokens), paste it here, Save, then Test. It's stored encrypted for this Windows user only. You can also right-click any fight in the tree to upload it on demand.
Settings_CooldownPerEffectTip: Quiet period after a callout for that effect — one stun wave is one call, not a stream.
Settings_KeepTrashForTip: Non-named fights are deleted for good past this window
Settings_LexiconLibraryEnabled: Use the EQ2Lexicon trigger & timer library
Settings_LexiconLibraryTip: Off = only the triggers and timers you make yourself apply. Turning it off removes all Lexicon-supplied ones; your own are untouched.
Settings_LexiconSyncHint: Curated triggers and timers from EQ2Lexicon appear as a read-only Lexicon section on the Triggers and Timers pages. Syncs automatically at startup; enable/disable choices stick across syncs.
Settings_LoadBossesFromTip: Named fights newer than this load at startup. Older ones stay in the archive forever — pull them back from the Archive window on the Main page.
Settings_PlayersBeforeItFiresTip: Distinct players hit within a few seconds before the callout fires. Higher = raid-wide AoEs only; 1 = every CC on anyone.
Settings_UploadFinishedFightsTip:
Every finished fight uploads in the background. The site keeps named (boss) kills for parses and rankings; trash fights are cleared automatically after a few days.
Needs a saved API token below.
Settings_UploadRaidOnlyTip:
Skips group and solo fights. A fight uploads when its target is on EQ2Lexicon's curated raid-boss list (synced from the site) or when 7 or more players took part.
Manual uploads from the fight tree always send.
Settings_VoiceDepthTip: Neural voices only — drags the pitch down for a deeper, bigger voice.
Settings_VoicePacksHint: Neural voices sound dramatically better than the built-in Windows voices below them in the list. Each pack downloads once, works fully offline, and can be removed here any time to reclaim the disk space.
Share_AlreadyHave: {0} shared a trigger you already have.

Sources_ChooseLogsFolderTitle: Choose the EQ2 logs folder (server subfolders are scanned too)
Sources_ModesHint: Live tail starts at the end; parse existing chews the whole log once; a watched folder tracks every active log by itself.
Sources_StatusSkipped: {0:N0} skipped on error (last: {1}) — see the crashes folder
Sources_TriggerTooSlow: A trigger under {0} was switched off for this session — its pattern took too long to match.
Sources_WatchFolderTip: Point at the EQ2 logs folder — any character's log that becomes active is tracked automatically
TimerPanel_EmptyHint: Timer bars appear here when a timer fires.
TimersVm_DurationInvalid: Duration must be a whole number of seconds.
TimersVm_EntriesSkippedMany: {0} entries skipped (bad regex or missing name)
TimersVm_EntriesSkippedOne: {0} entry skipped (bad regex or missing name)
TimersVm_FileNoEntries: The file contained no importable entries.
TimersVm_NameRequired: The timer needs a name — it matches the ability/spell name in the log.
TimersVm_NotActXml: Not a recognisable ACT XML export (no Trigger/Spell entries found).
TimersVm_NothingToImport: Nothing to import — paste ACT share XML first.
TimersVm_RemoveInvalid: Remove-at must be a whole number of seconds (negative = linger past zero).
TimersVm_WarningInvalid: Warning must be a whole number of seconds (0 = no warning).
Timers_AllowTimerModsTip:
Recast debuffs stretch the countdown: with Traumatic Swipe on the mob, a 30s timer starts at 45s (base × 1.5), and rescales if the swiper dies.
Tick for boss recasts (store the un-swiped base as Length); untick for fixed-length effects like a stifle duration.
Timers_BarColourTip:
The bar / dial fill colour in the timer overlay.
Worth a convention: red for raid-wide AoEs, purple for control, green for personal recasts.
Timers_CategoryLockTip:
Only start when the Category matches the caster, the victim, or the current zone.
This keeps a boss timer that boss's own — another mob casting a same-named ability won't start it. Untick to fire for any caster.
Timers_CategoryTip:
The mob this timer belongs to — used for tree grouping, and as the gate when 'category lock' is ticked (names must match the log exactly, articles included: 'a bisected rumbler').
A mob that splits into renamed copies shares one timer via |-separated names: the earth rumbler|bisected rumbler|trisected rumbler
Timers_ControlEffectTip:
The control it applies (stun, stifle, mez…) — shown on the timer bar so you know WHAT lands at zero and can pre-cure or joust.
Tag only: it never affects when the timer starts.
Timers_CopyShareTip: Copy share XML — send it to a friend, they paste it into their Import box
Timers_DamageTypeLabel: Damage type (toggle all that apply — first picked leads)
Timers_DamageTypeTip:
The schools the ability deals — shown on the timer bar so you know what's incoming (ward the right thing). The first school you toggle is the dominant one and drives the flame colour.
Tag only: it never affects when the timer starts. The curator fills it from measured hits.
Timers_EditTip: Click to edit in the panel on the right
Timers_EmptyBody: Create one on the right, or paste ACT share XML (<Spell … /> lines) into the import box. Triggers with a timer hook start these bars by name.
Timers_ImportHint: Paste ACT share XML — <Spell … /> and <Trigger … /> lines both work — or import a full ACT settings export file.
Timers_ImportXmlFileTip: Import an ACT settings export (Config with CustomTriggers + SpellTimers)
Timers_LengthTip:
Seconds from one cast to the next — the countdown length.
Use the curator's 'base' figure when swipe mods were in play: the live timer re-stretches itself whenever the mob actually gets swiped.
Timers_NameLabel: Name (matches the ability / trigger timer name)
Timers_NameTip:
The ability name exactly as the log spells it — any cast of it (re)starts the countdown.
A trigger with 'starts timer' set to this name starts it too, e.g. off a boss emote.
Timers_NewTimerTip: Clear the editor to create a fresh timer
Timers_OneAtATimeTip:
While the bar is running, new casts are ignored — it always runs to zero before it can start again.
Use when re-casts mid-window shouldn't reset the prediction (a scripted cycle, or an effect logged once per person it hits).
Timers_OnlyMineTip:
Only starts when YOU cast the ability — everyone else's casts are ignored.
E.g. track your own Harm Touch recast without the other shadowknight's casts restarting your bar. Leave off for boss timers.
Timers_PanelATip:
Show this timer in the Timers A overlay.
Run both overlays to split, say, boss timers (A) from your personal recasts (B).
Timers_PanelBTip: Show this timer in the Timers B overlay — the second, independently placed timer window (enable it on the Overlays page).
Timers_PreviewHint: Hit ▶ on a timer to preview it here and on the overlay.
Timers_RadialTip:
Show as a round dial in the dial row at the top of the timer overlay, instead of a bar in the list.
Best kept to the two or three timers you glance at constantly — the main AoE recast, not every DoT.
Timers_RemoveAtTip:
Seconds remaining when the bar disappears. Negative keeps it counting PAST zero: -15 shows it overdue for 15s.
Useful because bosses hold casts — the ability is still coming even though the countdown ran out.
Timers_StartSoundTip: Played when the timer starts (the ability just landed). Text is spoken aloud; a .wav path is played; just 'tts' speaks the timer's name; empty = silent.
Timers_SwipeTip: Stretched by a recast debuff (e.g. Traumatic Swipe)
Timers_TestTip: Test: start this timer now (watch the preview / overlay)
Timers_TooltipNoteTip: Free note shown when hovering the timer's row in the list — strat reminders, cast order, where the number came from.
Timers_WarnTip:
Seconds remaining when the bar goes urgent and the warning sound plays.
Pick your reaction time: 10s to pre-ward, 3s for a joust call.
Timers_WarningSoundTip: Played at the warn mark, before the ability comes back. Same rules: text spoken, .wav played, just 'tts' says '<name> soon', empty = silent.
Timers_ZoneTip:
Files the timer under this zone in the tree — and breaks ties: when the same mob + ability has a timer in two zones (Mayong in MMIS vs Castle Mistmoore), the zone you're standing in wins.
Leave blank for timers that apply anywhere.

TriggersVm_EntriesSkippedOne: {0} entry skipped (bad regex or missing name)

TriggersVm_NothingToImport: Nothing to import — paste ACT share XML first.
TriggersVm_SavedWithTimer: Saved. Also created spell timer “{0}” (30s default) — set its real length on the Timers page.
Triggers_AlertTip: What you hear on a match: a beep, spoken text (TTS), or a WAV file. 'None' still fires the timer below — useful for silent bookkeeping triggers.
Triggers_CategoryTip: The boss/mob the trigger belongs to — Zone → Mob → triggers in the tree, like timers.
Triggers_ClickToEditTip: Click to edit in the panel on the right
Triggers_CooldownTip:
Seconds after a fire before this trigger may fire again — stops an AoE that logs once per raider from repeating the call 24 times.
0 = every match fires.
Triggers_CopyShareXmlTip: Copy share XML — send it to a friend, they paste it into their Import box
Triggers_ImportHint: Paste ACT share XML — one <Trigger … /> per line — or import a full ACT settings export file.
Triggers_ImportXmlFileTip: Import an ACT settings export (Config with CustomTriggers + SpellTimers)
Triggers_NewTriggerTip: Clear the editor to create a fresh trigger
Triggers_NoTriggersHint: Create one on the right, or paste ACT share XML into the import box — 20 years of community triggers work here unchanged.
Triggers_OnlyInZoneTip:
Fire only while the current zone's name contains the Zone text (or the Category, for plain ACT imports with no Zone — ACT semantics).
E.g. Zone 'Emerald Halls' keeps a Wuoshi call quiet everywhere else — a same-worded emote on trash in another zone can't trip it.
Triggers_RecentFiresHint: Triggers that fire while you play appear here.
Triggers_RegexTip:
Checked against every combat-log line as it arrives; a match fires the alert.
Plain text works fine (no regex characters needed). Capture groups carry into the spoken text: (\w+) in the pattern, $1 in the speech.
Triggers_StartsTimerTip:
On a match, also start the linked spell timer — timers can run off emotes, not just casts.
The list is definitive: it offers the timers filed under this trigger's Zone + Category, and the link resolves to exactly that one. Make the timer first (Timers page or the curator) if it's not listed.
Triggers_TtsLabel: Text to speak — $1 inserts the first capture group
Triggers_ZoneTip:
Files the trigger under this zone in the tree, and is the gate text for 'only in this zone'.
Leave blank for anywhere-triggers (they file under General).
